criteria_schema.name: Unique identifier for the criterion within its scope (shared or a given type).
criteria_schema.check_type: 'structural' = deterministically computable from the prompt/params (field presence, length, enum membership, word-count-vs-duration math). 'semantic' = requires judgment (an LLM-as-judge pass) to assess, e.g. tone or physical plausibility.
criteria_schema.severity: 'blocking' = the compiled prompt should not be sent to generation until this passes; reserved for structural checks with an unambiguous failure condition. 'quality' = contributes to an aggregate quality score but does not by itself stop generation.
criteria_schema.weight: Relative importance (0-1) among the quality-severity criteria in the same scope, used to compute an aggregate quality score. Omitted for blocking criteria, since those gate rather than score.
criteria_schema.remediation: What the improve step should try when this criterion fails, phrased as an action the PromptHandler.update_* methods can perform.

fields.subject: Describe who/what is the focus in concrete, visually groundable terms; avoid abstract adjectives with no visual referent.
fields.action: Describe the motion/behavior happening over the clip; keep it achievable within a short clip rather than a multi-beat sequence.
fields.scene: Describe environment, background, and time of day with enough specificity to anchor lighting and mood.
fields.camera: Specify shot type and movement; must be physically compatible with the described action.
fields.lighting: Specify lighting style/mood; must not contradict the scene's implied lighting conditions.
fields.style: Name a concrete visual/style reference (rendering style, film stock, animation technique) rather than a vague quality adjective like 'high quality'.
fields.negative_prompt: List concrete failure modes to avoid for this content type, not generic boilerplate.

evaluation_criteria.name: specificity
evaluation_criteria.description: Every field uses concrete, visually groundable language rather than vague filler adjectives ('beautiful', 'amazing', 'high quality') with no visual referent.
evaluation_criteria.remediation: Replace vague adjectives with concrete descriptors specific to the subject/scene (material, color, shape, texture, expression).

evaluation_criteria.name: camera_action_consistency
evaluation_criteria.description: Camera movement is physically compatible with the described action.
evaluation_criteria.remediation: Adjust camera to a movement achievable given the described action (e.g. don't pair 'static shot' with 'fast tracking chase').

evaluation_criteria.name: lighting_scene_consistency
evaluation_criteria.description: Lighting description does not contradict the scene's implied time of day/environment.
evaluation_criteria.remediation: Align lighting with the scene's implied conditions (e.g. don't pair 'midnight' with 'bright midday sun').

evaluation_criteria.name: negative_prompt_coverage
evaluation_criteria.description: Negative prompt names concrete failure modes relevant to this content type, not generic boilerplate.
evaluation_criteria.remediation: Add failure-mode terms specific to this type's ruleset (see per-type negative_prompt guidance) instead of generic terms like 'bad quality, blurry'.

evaluation_criteria.name: duration_feasibility
evaluation_criteria.description: The described action is achievable within the requested clip duration without needing multiple narrative beats.
evaluation_criteria.remediation: Collapse multi-beat action into a single continuous motion, or reduce the number of described events.

evaluation_criteria.name: field_non_empty
evaluation_criteria.description: Every required field (subject, action, scene, camera, lighting, style) is a non-empty string after stripping whitespace.
evaluation_criteria.remediation: Populate any empty required field before sending the prompt to generation; this should never reach the evaluator for a validly constructed PromptComponents instance.

pixar.style_guidance: Reference 3D animated feature conventions: stylized character proportions, warm rim lighting, expressive readable motion.

evaluation_criteria.name: style_named
evaluation_criteria.description: Style field names a concrete animation convention/reference, not just 'cartoon' or 'animated'.
evaluation_criteria.remediation: Name a specific rendering convention, e.g. '3D animated feature style, stylized proportions, warm rim lighting'.

evaluation_criteria.name: motion_readability
evaluation_criteria.description: Action is exaggerated/readable enough for a stylized 3D render rather than dependent on subtle micro-expression.
evaluation_criteria.remediation: Amplify the described motion into a clearer, larger physical gesture.

action.style_guidance: Favor kinetic camera language and impact-driven pacing.

evaluation_criteria.name: motion_complexity
evaluation_criteria.description: More than one fast-moving interacting subject is described; current models degrade sharply with multi-entity fast motion.
evaluation_criteria.remediation: Reduce to a single primary moving subject, or split the shot into separate generations.

evaluation_criteria.name: prop_continuity
evaluation_criteria.description: Any weapon/prop/tool mentioned in action has corresponding coverage in negative_prompt against morphing.
evaluation_criteria.remediation: Add the prop's name plus 'morphing, warping, extra limbs' to negative_prompt.

evaluation_criteria.name: impact_physics
evaluation_criteria.description: Impacts/collisions imply a plausible physical consequence (debris, recoil, follow-through) rather than being stated as instantaneous.
evaluation_criteria.remediation: Add a physical consequence phrase following the impact (e.g. 'debris scatters', 'staggers backward').

animation.style_guidance: Name the specific animation technique (2D cel-shaded, stop-motion, cutout) rather than 'animation' alone.

evaluation_criteria.name: technique_named
evaluation_criteria.description: Style specifies a concrete animation technique.
evaluation_criteria.remediation: Name the specific technique (2D cel-shaded, stop-motion, cutout, paper animation).

evaluation_criteria.name: motion_readability
evaluation_criteria.description: Action is exaggerated/readable enough for the named technique.
evaluation_criteria.remediation: Amplify the described motion into a clearer, larger physical gesture appropriate to the technique.

anime.style_guidance: Reference specific anime visual conventions (cel-shading, speed lines, dramatic zoom) and era/studio influence if relevant.

evaluation_criteria.name: technique_named
evaluation_criteria.description: Style specifies concrete anime conventions, not just the word 'anime'.
evaluation_criteria.remediation: Name specific conventions (cel-shading, speed lines, dramatic zoom, era/studio influence).

evaluation_criteria.name: expression_intensity
evaluation_criteria.description: Character expression/action is stylistically exaggerated in line with anime convention.
evaluation_criteria.remediation: Heighten expression or motion intensity to match anime convention.

documentary.style_guidance: Favor observational, photorealistic camera language; avoid overtly stylized camera moves that break documentary realism.

evaluation_criteria.name: camera_realism
evaluation_criteria.description: Camera field avoids highly stylized moves (e.g. dramatic dutch angle) that undercut documentary authenticity, unless deliberate.
evaluation_criteria.remediation: Replace stylized camera language with observational terms (handheld, static tripod, slow pan).

evaluation_criteria.name: subject_naturalism
evaluation_criteria.description: Subject description avoids overtly staged/posed language inconsistent with observational footage.
evaluation_criteria.remediation: Rephrase posed/staged language into candid, in-the-moment description.

fashion.style_guidance: Specify wardrobe/material detail and editorial lighting convention (studio strobe, natural window light).

evaluation_criteria.name: wardrobe_detail
evaluation_criteria.description: Subject description includes garment/material detail relevant to the shot's purpose.
evaluation_criteria.remediation: Add fabric, silhouette, or color detail about the wardrobe to the subject field.

evaluation_criteria.name: camera_editorial_fit
evaluation_criteria.description: Camera work matches editorial/runway convention (slow tracking, low angle) rather than generic framing.
evaluation_criteria.remediation: Specify an editorial camera convention (slow-motion tracking, low-angle runway shot).

extra_fields.dialogue: Write as natural spoken speech, not written prose; keep it speakable within the clip duration.
extra_fields.reference_image: Set whenever exact product appearance (label, packaging, shape) matters.

ugc_product_review.style_guidance: Favor 'handheld, amateur, phone camera, unpolished' language; avoid cinematic vocabulary that undercuts authenticity.

evaluation_criteria.name: authenticity_tone
evaluation_criteria.description: Style/camera reads as informal/handheld, not polished/cinematic.
evaluation_criteria.remediation: Replace cinematic language in style/camera with informal/handheld equivalents.

evaluation_criteria.name: product_reference_present
evaluation_criteria.description: reference_image is set when product visual accuracy matters.
evaluation_criteria.remediation: Set reference_image to a real product photo.

evaluation_criteria.name: dialogue_duration_fit
evaluation_criteria.description: Dialogue word count, at ~2.5 words/second natural speaking pace, fits within params.duration_s.
evaluation_criteria.remediation: Trim dialogue to roughly duration_s * 2.5 words, or increase duration_s in GenerationParams.

extra_fields.dialogue: Usually left unset; a voiceover is typically layered separately from the visual generation.
extra_fields.reference_image: Set whenever exact product appearance (label, packaging, shape) matters.

commercial_product_ad.style_guidance: Favor polished studio language: controlled lighting, smooth camera moves (orbit/dolly), commercial pacing.

evaluation_criteria.name: product_reference_present
evaluation_criteria.description: reference_image is set when product visual accuracy matters.
evaluation_criteria.remediation: Set reference_image to a real product photo.

evaluation_criteria.name: polish_tone
evaluation_criteria.description: Style/camera reads as polished/commercial, the opposite of the UGC authenticity requirement.
evaluation_criteria.remediation: Replace informal/handheld language in style/camera with studio/commercial equivalents.

extra_fields.dialogue: Write as clear, informative, persuasive speech rather than casual chatter.
extra_fields.reference_image: Set when a consistent speaker/product identity is required.

evaluation_criteria.name: dialogue_duration_fit
evaluation_criteria.description: Dialogue word count, at ~2.5 words/second natural speaking pace, fits within params.duration_s.
evaluation_criteria.remediation: Trim dialogue to roughly duration_s * 2.5 words, or increase duration_s in GenerationParams.

evaluation_criteria.name: clarity_of_framing
evaluation_criteria.description: Camera keeps the subject clearly framed and centered for message clarity.
evaluation_criteria.remediation: Set camera to a centered medium shot with minimal movement.

extra_fields.dialogue: Write as scripted speech; this is the primary content of the clip.
extra_fields.reference_image: Set to anchor a consistent identity across multiple separate generations of the same presenter.
extra_fields.voice_tone: Set explicitly (e.g. 'warm, confident, corporate') rather than left unset.

presenter_avatar.style_guidance: Favor static or minimal camera movement and direct-to-camera framing.

evaluation_criteria.name: identity_consistency
evaluation_criteria.description: reference_image is set whenever the same presenter will appear across multiple generations.
evaluation_criteria.remediation: Set reference_image to the presenter's identity anchor image.

evaluation_criteria.name: voice_tone_specified
evaluation_criteria.description: voice_tone is set and specific rather than left unset.
evaluation_criteria.remediation: Set voice_tone to a specific descriptor (e.g. 'warm, confident, corporate').

evaluation_criteria.name: dialogue_duration_fit
evaluation_criteria.description: Dialogue word count, at ~2.5 words/second natural speaking pace, fits within params.duration_s.
evaluation_criteria.remediation: Trim dialogue to roughly duration_s * 2.5 words, or increase duration_s in GenerationParams.

extra_fields.dialogue: Write as a fast, hook-driven opening line plus short follow-through.
extra_fields.reference_image: Set whenever a specific product/identity must appear.
extra_fields.text_overlay: Keep short enough to read comfortably within the clip duration.
extra_fields.aspect_ratio: Use a valid vertical short-form ratio (e.g. '9:16') unless explicitly overridden.

social_short_form_ad.style_guidance: Favor fast pacing, hook-driven opening action, vertical framing.

evaluation_criteria.name: caption_length_fit
evaluation_criteria.description: text_overlay character count, at ~15 readable chars/second, fits within params.duration_s.
evaluation_criteria.remediation: Trim text_overlay to roughly duration_s * 15 characters, or increase duration_s.

evaluation_criteria.name: aspect_ratio_valid
evaluation_criteria.description: aspect_ratio is one of the known vertical short-form ratios ('9:16', '4:5').
evaluation_criteria.remediation: Set aspect_ratio to '9:16' unless the target platform requires otherwise.

evaluation_criteria.name: dialogue_duration_fit
evaluation_criteria.description: Dialogue word count, at ~2.5 words/second natural speaking pace, fits within params.duration_s.
evaluation_criteria.remediation: Trim dialogue to roughly duration_s * 2.5 words, or increase duration_s in GenerationParams.

extra_fields.audio_reference: Must be set; visuals cannot be evaluated for sync without a reference track.
extra_fields.tempo_bpm: Set so cuts/transformations can be timed to the beat.

music_video.style_guidance: Favor rhythm/beat-synced visual language over narrative action language.

evaluation_criteria.name: audio_reference_present
evaluation_criteria.description: audio_reference is set to a non-empty value.
evaluation_criteria.remediation: Set audio_reference to the track this clip must sync to before evaluating further.

evaluation_criteria.name: tempo_specified
evaluation_criteria.description: tempo_bpm is set.
evaluation_criteria.remediation: Set tempo_bpm from the reference track's known BPM.

music_video.caveat: No currently integrated model (Wan/HunyuanVideo/LTX/etc.) natively supports audio-synced generation; this type is defined for future support.

extra_fields.text_content: Keep short enough to be legible within the clip duration.
extra_fields.transitions: Name a concrete transition style (fade, slide, zoom) rather than leaving it generic.

motion_graphics.style_guidance: Favor abstract/graphic style language (flat design, iconography, kinetic typography) over photoreal/cinematic vocabulary.

evaluation_criteria.name: text_length_fit
evaluation_criteria.description: text_content character count, at ~15 readable chars/second, fits within params.duration_s.
evaluation_criteria.remediation: Trim text_content to roughly duration_s * 15 characters, or increase duration_s.

evaluation_criteria.name: transitions_named
evaluation_criteria.description: transitions names a concrete transition style rather than being left unset.
evaluation_criteria.remediation: Set transitions to a concrete style (fade, slide, zoom, wipe).

motion_graphics.caveat: This content type is better served by templated motion-graphics tooling than diffusion text-to-video models; none of the currently integrated models target this output style.

image_fields.subject: Describe who/what is the focus in concrete, visually groundable terms; avoid abstract adjectives with no visual referent.
image_fields.scene: Describe environment, background, and time of day with enough specificity to anchor lighting and mood.
image_fields.camera: Specify shot type, angle, and framing; must be physically compatible with what the subject/scene description can show.
image_fields.lighting: Specify lighting style, direction, and mood; must not contradict the scene's implied lighting conditions.
image_fields.style: Name a concrete visual/artistic style or medium reference (photography genre, render engine, art movement) rather than a vague quality adjective like 'high quality'.
image_fields.action: Optional. Describe the subject's pose or momentary action as a single plausible instant; omit rather than implying motion a still frame can't convey.
image_fields.color_palette: Optional. Name the dominant tones/color scheme; must not contradict lighting or scene.
image_fields.negative_prompt: Optional. List concrete failure modes to avoid for this subject/style, not generic boilerplate.

image_evaluation_criteria.name: specificity
image_evaluation_criteria.description: Every field uses concrete, visually groundable language rather than vague filler adjectives ('beautiful', 'amazing', 'high quality') with no visual referent.
image_evaluation_criteria.remediation: Replace vague adjectives with concrete descriptors specific to the subject/scene (material, color, shape, texture, expression).

image_evaluation_criteria.name: camera_scene_consistency
image_evaluation_criteria.description: Camera framing/angle is physically plausible for the described subject and scene (e.g. an extreme close-up doesn't contradict a 'full body' subject description).
image_evaluation_criteria.remediation: Adjust camera framing to match what the subject/scene description can actually show.

image_evaluation_criteria.name: lighting_scene_consistency
image_evaluation_criteria.description: Lighting description does not contradict the scene's implied time of day/environment.
image_evaluation_criteria.remediation: Align lighting with the scene's implied conditions (e.g. don't pair 'midnight' with 'bright midday sun').

image_evaluation_criteria.name: color_palette_consistency
image_evaluation_criteria.description: When set, color_palette does not contradict the described lighting or scene.
image_evaluation_criteria.remediation: Adjust color_palette to tones plausible given the lighting/scene, or clear it if it can't be reconciled.

image_evaluation_criteria.name: negative_prompt_coverage
image_evaluation_criteria.description: Negative prompt names concrete failure modes relevant to this subject/style, not generic boilerplate.
image_evaluation_criteria.remediation: Add failure-mode terms specific to the subject/style (e.g. anatomical errors for portraits, warped text for typography) instead of generic terms like 'bad quality, blurry'.

image_evaluation_criteria.name: static_action_plausibility
image_evaluation_criteria.description: When set, action describes a single plausible instant/pose rather than an implied sequence of motion a still frame can't convey.
image_evaluation_criteria.remediation: Collapse a multi-beat action into the single instant being captured, or remove action if the subject is purely static.

image_evaluation_criteria.name: field_non_empty
image_evaluation_criteria.description: Every required field (subject, scene, camera, lighting, style) is a non-empty string after stripping whitespace.
image_evaluation_criteria.remediation: Populate any empty required field before sending the prompt to generation; this should never reach the evaluator for a validly constructed ImagePromptComponents instance.
